text: I want to compare aircraft turnarounds from an inbound arrival to the next departure. For each turnaround, show the inbound flight's landing and in-block arrival, the start of ground handling, completion of passenger disembarkation, baggage unloading, cabin cleaning, refuelling and catering loading, then the outbound flight's boarding start and close, baggage loading close, aircraft ready time, off-block departure and take-off. List the events in chronological order.

I want to compare departure preparation for on-time and delayed flights. For each outbound flight, show when boarding started and closed, when baggage loading closed, when the aircraft was ready, and when it actually went off-block. List the events in chronological order.
For each passenger flight leg, show the records for completed check-in and confirmed boarding at the gate.

I want to analyse security queue time and screening time separately. For each security checkpoint visit, show when the passenger joined the queue, when screening began and when it finished, in chronological order.
For each passenger flight leg, show completed check-in and confirmed boarding. If the passenger checked any bags, also show when each bag was accepted and loaded.
